title.zh: 将医疗与牙科服务移交给教育部的法案
title.en: An Act Transferring the Medical and Dental Services to the Department of Education
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Medical and Dental Services to the Department of Education

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_847_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Medical and Dental Services in the Public Schools which is now functioning as a division of Bureau of Health, since January first, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, is hereby transferred or returned back the Department of Education as a division of that Department where it originally belonged from nineteen hundred and forty-six to nineteen hundred and fifty: Provided, That the supervision of hygiene and sanitation shall be exercised by the Department of Health.
All laws, acts, executive orders, or parts thereof, inconsistent with the provision of this act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted on May 23, 1953, without the Executive approval.
